summary: Advanced Energy Industries filed an 8-K announcing the redemption of all $136.7M of its outstanding 2.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028. The redemption price is 100% of principal plus accrued interest, set for September 23, 2026. The company will settle conversions by paying cash for principal and delivering common stock at a conversion price of ~$137.46 per share, with a small conversion rate increase of 0.0743 shares per $1,000 principal. This mandatory redemption reduces debt and dilutes equity. Watch for conversion behavior and share count impact; risk-arb is limited as this is a redemption, not a tender.
